$comment: Golden classification of every cloudru-vm engine tool. allow requires a BEHAVIOUR audit of the handler at the pinned engine SHA proving both axes: (1) observational with no cloud mutation, job advancement or secret return (a local plan write is disclosed), and (2) no user-controlled argument reaching shell/exec/SSH. Shell-reaching tools remain ask even when arguments are quoted. Schema shape alone never proves allow. The old baseline had two hazards: stack_status advanced planned jobs into paid actions and logs inserted an unescaped service into a shell command. In the pinned engine, stack_status reads persisted state only; stack_apply explicitly advances jobs, and logs shell-quotes service. The specific regression tests are in go/cloudru-vm/internal/mcp/stack_status_test.go and internal/engine/logs_test.go. Any unknown live tool fails drift checks; deny by default.
